name: EZ Bar Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at the preacher bench with your upper arms supported on the pad and hold the EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Begin with your arms extended down the pad with a slight unlock at the elbows.
Curl the EZ bar smoothly upward toward your shoulders while keeping your upper arms pressed into the pad.
Lower the bar slowly back down to the bottom stretch under full control.
tips: Do not lift your elbows off the pad or lean backward to assist the lift.
Avoid bouncing out of the bottom position to protect your biceps tendons.
